components.content:
# Human Effects when Exposed to Low-Frequency Noise or Vibration

Physiological effects from low-frequency noise and vibrations.

## Comfort Assessments of Vibration Environments

This tool helps assess human perception and comfort levels when exposed to low-frequency noise or vibration based on acceleration measurements.

**Note:** 1 m/s² = 3.28 ft/s²

outputs.label: Human Perception Level
outputs.formula: inputs.vibration_level < 0.315 ? 'Not uncomfortable' : inputs.vibration_level <= 0.63 ? 'A little uncomfortable' : inputs.vibration_level <= 1 ? 'Fairly uncomfortable' : inputs.vibration_level <= 1.6 ? 'Uncomfortable' : inputs.vibration_level <= 2.5 ? 'Very uncomfortable' : 'Extremely uncomfortable'

title.text: Human Perception Scale for Vibration Levels
